title: IKEA Recalls Children's Folding Tent Due to Laceration and Puncture Hazards
summary: The steel wire frame of the tent can break, producing sharp wire ends that can protrude through the tent fabric, posing a laceration or puncture hazard. Units: About 58,000; 51,000 in the United States and 7,000 in Canada.

title: Yu Wei Recalls Drop-Side Cribs Sold Exclusively at jcpenney Due to Entrapment and Suffocation Hazards
summary: The drop-side rails on the crib can malfunction, detach or unexpectedly fall down, causing part of the drop side to fall out of position. title: Ballard Designs Recalls Step Stools Due to Fall Hazard
summary: Plastic tabs on the feet of the step stools can cause the stools to be unstable, posing a fall hazard to consumers. Units: About 2,500.

title: Electric Motion Systems, LLC Recalls Lithium-Poly Battery Pack Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The battery can overheat and catch fire. Units: About 70.

title: Target Recall Children's Frog Masks Due to Suffocation Hazard
summary: The plush frog masks lack proper ventilation. When secured in place across a child's face, it presents a suffocation hazard to the child. Units: About 3,400.

title: Guidecraft Recalls Twist 'n Sort Toys Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The small pegs on three of the four posts can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 760.

title: Horizon Hobby Recalls Losi NiMH Battery Charger Due to Possible Burn and Fire Hazards
summary: The charger and battery can emit excessive heat, posing a burn and fire hazard. Units: About 975.

title: LittleLife Baby Carriers Recalled by Lifemarque Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The carriers were sold without bolts that attach the carrier's main frame to the metal stand. Missing bolts cause the carrier to disconnect from the stand and fall backwards, posing a fall hazard to a child in the carrier. Units: About 40 in the United States and 10 in Canada.

title: Jogging Strollers Recalled by B.O.B. Trailers Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The stroller canopy's embroidered logo's backing patch can detach, posing a choking hazard to babies and young children. Units: About 411,700 in the United States and 27,000 in Canada (357,000 units were recalled in February 2011 due to strangulation hazard posed by canopy drawstring).

title: Nidec Motor Corporation Recalls Pool Pump Motors Due to Electrical Shock Hazard
summary: The pump cover is not properly grounded posing an electrical shock hazard. Units: Approximately 2,000.

title: Bicycles Recalled by Trek Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The bolt that secures the seat saddle clamp to the seat post can break posing a fall hazard. Units: About 27,000.

title: Hand Trucks Recalled by Harper Trucks Due to Injury Hazard
summary: When the tires are overinflated, they can explode causing the wheel hub to separate or break, ejecting pieces of the hub. This poses an injury hazard to bystanders. Units: About 292,000.

title: Bad Boy Buggies Recalled by BB Buggies Due to Loss of Steering Control and Crash Hazard
summary: The steering assembly arm can break and cause the driver to lose control, posing a crash hazard. Units: About 3,200 (Note: Bad Boy Classic buggies were previously recalled in October 2009 and in December 2010).

title: Big Lots Recalls Glider Recliners with Ottomans Due to Entrapment and Finger Crushing Hazards
summary: An exposed gap between the moving parts of the chair and the base framework can allow access to toddlers and infants, posing an entrapment hazard. title: General Electric Recalls Gas Rangetop with Grill Due to an Explosion Hazard
summary: Burners on Rangetops operating on liquefied petroleum ("LP" or propane) may fail to ignite or light if the gas control knob is left in a position between OFF and LITE, posing a risk of delayed ignition or explosion. Units: About 470.
